info.title: Product Umbrella
info.description: Tracking platform API: clicks, conversions, campaigns, offers, landings, stats.

bearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_TOKEN>, or a personal API key Bearer umb_… that acts as its user (same role and campaign scope).

cookieAuth.name: umb_session
cookieAuth.description: Session cookie. Mutating requests also require X-Requested-With: umbrella.

lastUsedAt.description: Updated at most once a minute

conversionCap.description: Lead + sale conversions per local day in capTz

capTz.description: IANA time zone of the cap day

altOfferId.description: Offer that takes the traffic when the conversion cap is reached (chain up to 3 hops)

sourcePostbackUrl.description: Campaign override of the traffic-source postback URL (https, macros {click_id}, {external_id}, {sub_id_N}, {status}, {revenue}, {payout}, {currency}…); null = use the source's

sourcePostbackStatuses.description: Statuses that trigger the source postback; empty = use the source's

currency.name: currency
currency.description: 3-letter ISO currency code for conversion. Defaults to DEFAULT_CURRENCY (EUR).

get.description: Picks a stream by conditions/weights, records the click, and redirects the visitor to the chosen offer or landing. Supports forced/regular/fallback stream types and cross-campaign routing.

302.description: Redirect to offer or landing URL

404.description: Campaign not found / inactive / no matching stream

get.description: Records a click and redirects the visitor to the specified offer URL. Backward-compatible explicit routing.
The landing page button calls this endpoint with click_id. The tracker sends the visitor to the pre-selected offer URL, carrying the same click_id so postbacks work normally.
Called by the affiliate network to report a conversion. Requires click_id and optionally revenue, currency, status. If POSTBACK_SECRET is set, the secret parameter must match.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Conversion status. Synonyms: pending/hold→lead, approved/confirmed/paid→sale, declined/cancelled/refund/chargeback→rejected, fraud/duplicate→trash. Omit for sale.

get.description: Returns server status, active storage backend, GeoIP availability, and uptime.
Returns click/conversion/revenue metrics grouped by campaign, offer, stream, landing, and country. Buyers see only their own campaigns.
Returns clicks/conversions/revenue grouped by day or hour.
Compares the selected period to the preceding equal-length period. Returns current/previous stats and deltaPct for clicks, conversions, revenue.

400.description: from and to dates are required

get.description: Downloads statistics as UTF-8 CSV with BOM (for Excel). Values starting with formula characters are prefixed with an apostrophe.
Returns the top referring URLs by click count.
Returns the top request paths by click count.
Groups clicks/conversions/revenue by values of a traffic-source parameter (sub_id_1..30, keyword, source, etc.) or a dimension field (device, os, browser, language, isp).

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Parameter or dimension to group by. Returns 400 for unknown values.

get.description: Paginated click log. Buyers see only their own campaigns' clicks. Requires admin authorization.
Paginated conversion log. Buyers see only their own campaigns' conversions. Requires admin authorization.

conversionCap.description: Lead + sale conversions per local day in capTz

capTz.description: IANA time zone of the cap day

altOfferId.description: Offer that takes the traffic when the conversion cap is reached (chain up to 3 hops)

conversionCap.description: Lead + sale conversions per local day in capTz

capTz.description: IANA time zone of the cap day

altOfferId.description: Offer that takes the traffic when the conversion cap is reached (chain up to 3 hops)

get.description: Buyers see only their own campaigns.

put.description: Replaces the entire stream list for a campaign. Streams with invalid data are dropped. Returns 400 if all submitted streams are invalid.

get.description: Returns the current user, whether setup is required, and whether login is required.

post.description: One-time setup endpoint. Returns 409 if an owner already exists. Requires ADMIN_TOKEN when configured.
Authenticates a user and sets a session cookie. Rate-limited to 10 failures per 15 minutes per IP.
Deletes the current session and clears the session cookie.

get.description: Owner only.

post.description: Owner only. Creates a buyer or owner account.

delete.description: Owner only. Cannot delete yourself or the last owner.

409.description: Cannot delete self or last owner

get.description: Own keys. The owner (or ADMIN_TOKEN) lists every key with ?all=1. The secret is never returned.

post.description: Logged-in user only (not ADMIN_TOKEN, not another API key). The secret umb_… is returned once; only its SHA-256 and last 4 characters are stored.

delete.description: Own key; the owner may delete any.

get.description: Owner only. Rules from ADMIN_ALLOWED_IPS and the caller's IP as the server sees it. Not editable over the API.
Returns team-level settings such as buyerSharePct.
Returns change history: who changed what and when. Buyers see only their own entries.
Returns the primary host and list of additional tracking domains from deploy/domains.txt.
Returns current exchange rates and last update time. Rates are refreshed every 12 hours from open.er-api.com.
